6b09ef365f766dde.title: Macy's parade faced a historic postponement. Saturday's forecast is looking better.
6b09ef365f766dde.summary: The annual Macy s Thanksgiving Day Parade is set to go ahead Saturday after being postponed for the first time in its history due to severe weather . The 100th parade will now step off at 8:30 a.m. ET on Saturday, Nov. 28. NBC and Peacock will air it at 8:30 a.m. in the Eastern, Central and Mountain time zones and at 7:30 a.m. Pacific, according to NBC , with a Spanish-language simulcast on Telemundo. Some performers have needed to scramble to ensure they can take part in the rescheduled event.
